#Fanfiction #VioletEvergarden
#Fanfiction #VioletEvergarden
~ Sudden Work ~
The sun rose over the city of Leiden, the capital of Leidenschaftlich, the southern middle part of Telesis. The war had ended only two years before and Violet was now getting used to her job as an Automemories Doll. She loved the job, as much as she had loved The Major.
The Major. She couldn't even say his name or that rank without thinking of him. Having just finished a job outside of the city, Violet arrived by the train in the late afternoon. Heading to the back to CH Postal Company, owned by Claudia Hodgins, the man who had helped give her a chance and whom The Major had trusted with her care.
Violet did not know her true age, as a child soldier in the Leidenschaftlich Army, she had no idea who her parents were. She had been treated as nothing more than a tool.
That was until she was placed in the hands of Major Guilbert Bougainvillea. He had saw her as a Human being, he had loved her. She had not understood emotions, all she did was fight. His last words as they tried to escape their last mission had been confusing to her.
"I love you, Violet."
She had not known what that meant, she had told him so, "What does that mean? Tell me Major, what does that mean?" Just as the entire place was hit by the Artillery.
Waking up in a hospital bed, she had her arms replaced. During the attack and her attempt to save The Major's life, she had lost both her arms from the shoulders down. Replaced with Augmetic prosthetics, she had taken time to learn how to use them.
Claudia Hodgins had given her a job at his new postal company and from there, it was a ride.
She learnt emotions, working as an Automemories Doll meant she had to translate a person's words and feelings into a letter they truly wanted to send, even if their mouth did not say the words. Her first letter had been embarrassing, she had been too forward and honest, the woman meant the opposite of what she said but Violet had no understood.
Arriving at the CH Postal Company, she greeted her companions and was placing her bag down at her desk when Claudia came in. He had a job for her already.
"I am sorry that you only just come back Violet. But we got a client who asked for someone like you, someone who fought in the war."
Nodding, she turned and took the letter, reading it, and folded it perfectly into her bag. "I will go where ever I am needed sir." She smiled up at him, that was a new thing.
Smiling felt good, it made people around her smile too, before she had not known how to smile but now she did. Getting used to when to smile was a hard thing but she managed it often enough without problems.
It was late afternoon when Violet arrived by the taxi cab, the driver getting out to help her with the door. "Thank you" She handed him the bills for the trip and approached the door. Knocking with a gloved hand, she tended to wear these to hide her prosthetics from people, she waited until the door opened.
As the door opened, Violet was first seen by her client. Blonde hair tied into a braid and ending in two buns at the back of her head, she wore a flowing puffy dress with a blue top, almost militaristic in nature if it was not a dress for a fancy woman in a fancy job. Automemories dolls were the best a Postal Service could do for you so they had to look nice.
Bowing her head, she spoke as she bowed and curtsied for the client in front of her.
"It is a pleasure to meet you, if it is your wish, I will travel anywhere to meet you. Automemories Doll, Violet Evergarden at your service. Violet Evergarden" She recited her greeting and stood straight, smiling softly again.
"I have come at your request for an Automemories Doll."
Standing before her was a man dressed in Slacks and blouse with suspenders and loafers holding a cup of coffee. It was a fresh cup and the aroma flowed towards her as the air left the house. It was a foreign blend a dark roast. He didn't add any creamer or sugar to it so it was straight. The male had long Teal hair and amber eyes.
His eyes looked like they were strained, not from lack of sleep or exhaustion, but of something internal. mental. But he had a smile upon seeing the young Blond.
"Pleased to meet you. My name is Ludwig. Major formerly of the Leidenschaftlich Special Unit Stosstruppen. SUS for short. Come on in and have a seat." He said as he stepped aside allowing her some room to enter before closing the door behind her. the house was quaint with some pictures frames leading up a stair well to the second floor, he headed to the back where the kitchen was as he continued to speak.
"I just made a fresh pot of coffee. Would you care for some?"
Smiling at the man, Violet bowed again. "It is a pleasure to meet you Major Ludwig." Stepping inside, she made her way into the middle of the room and turned to face him.
"I am sufficiently refreshed, although a glass of water will be nice." She replied, "Coffee has an unpleasant affect on me, I prefer not to drink it." She explained and looked around the room. In her hands was an overly large briefcase that opened with a split top, it looked huge compared to normal cases but she carried it without any hindrance.
She also carried a long blue parasol which hooked onto the case.
"If you would like to begin now, we can discuss your letter. All I require is somewhere to place my typewriter." She motioned one hand to the case, lifting the case with one hand with ease.
"Alright well head into the living room there to your left I will be there in a moment. there is a desk for you to set up your typewriter." He said from the kitchen. He would return with a glass of water with some ice in it to keep it chilled.
"Even if you don't like the brew I can't seem to stop drinking it. I use to only drink one cup but since the war It seems to be the only thing that gets me going now a days."
Bowing when he told her where to go, she would be all set up when he came back in with the water. Stood at the side of the seat in front of her Typewriter, Violet had her brown leather gloved hands on her lap and facing him as he came in, gently taking the glass from his hand.
Her hands make a slight tinkling noise as they closed around the glass and clasped the glass through the leather gloves. There was something off about the way her gloves fit to her fingers, almost too slender and curved.
"Thank you." She spoke and sipped the water before placing it down beside the typewriter. She moved like a maid in a fancy hall or some toy doll. No wonder their job was given the title of "Doll". She really did look like a living doll.
"I understand how hard it is to continue after the war. I myself was a soldier." She spoke honestly, the look in her eyes gave that stare as she looked at him. One that no civilian could make up when lying about being a soldier.
However she looked so young, she could be no older than 16, she was shorter than he was and her body was so perfect, or at least the parts of her not covered by the elaborate dress.
"It is hard to continue after such a traumatic event. I have lost someone close to me in the War, but I made a promise to continue on." She nodded and took a seat at the desk.
"Whom is the letter to be addressed to? Is it a friend, loved one or an acquaintance?"
He reached over to a drawer above the desk and pulled out an envelope and opened it up. He set down a sheet of paper in front of her. There were 78 names on it with various addresses to them.
"Promised these men that I would write home to their loved ones telling them how they lived and what was on their minds. I haven't been able to do so since then but hearing about your services I figured it would be best to have you write what I say better."
"I will make sure that the stories you tell me of them will be put down into words adequate for your liking." Violet spoke and took the paper in her hands, slowly reading through every name to see if she knew any of them.
She knew a lot of soldiers in her years in the war, many knew her for her role as "Leidenschaftlich Soldier Maiden". Although her renown was not a positive one; she had murdered quite a lot of the enemy.
So many that they had decided to bring an entire Front Line Artillery Division to stop her squads rampage in the command centre.
"If you wish to begin now, we can, or we can begin in the morning. I was told of this job only as I returned to Leiden but I can go to my hotel and we can start tomorrow?" Violet suggested, placing her hands on her lap.
"Lets start with the First name on the list. Karl Ludendorff. To his wife."

William Blake is a writer down on his luck. With a string of successful books, he has struck upon the foul curse of Writers Block. His wife, Rebecca Blake, struggles to help her husband deal with it and it is straining their marriage. Then walks in an old flame.
Emma Jackson was Blake's University fling and mysteriously vanished one day without a trace, now she's back just as the rocks start to appear in Blake's marriage.
Unfortunately for Blake, he ends up trapped in Limbo, a world powered by creativity layered beneath our own and must write something to help himself escape. Constantly returning to 'The Writers Room' a place of seemingly solidity in the void of Limbo, Blake makes this his own Citadel of Darkness.

#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox “IMG” is not created yet. Click to create.
#Book #FeraWorld
Noble Blood, Tainted Hands is a gritty, character-driven crime thriller set in the industrial city of Ilmaria (City), a sprawling metropolis rife with corruption, poverty, and crime. The story follows Lorenza de Calis, a junior constable and outcast from her prestigious military family, as she descends into the city’s criminal underworld and struggles to reclaim her life and her sense of justice.
The novel begins with Lorenza being assigned a cold case: the disappearance of a young seamstress, Esther Moore, a decade prior. Her investigation uncovers ties to an underground syndicate trafficking in drugs, forced labour, and human lives. When a raid on the syndicate goes catastrophically wrong, her unit is massacred, and Lorenza is captured. Enslaved and drugged with a substance called "Dust," which creates a deadly dependency, Lorenza is subjected to brutal conditions as the syndicate tries to break her will.
Resilient and cunning, Lorenza manipulates a young syndicate member into falling in love with her, a gambit that ultimately allows her to escape. Her return to Ilmaria (City) is far from a triumphant homecoming. The constabulary accuses her of collusion in the failed raid, using her captivity as evidence against her, while her family, already estranged due to her career choice, disowns her completely.
With no allies and her reputation destroyed, Lorenza takes justice into her own hands. She embarks on a vigilante mission to dismantle the syndicate, uncovering layer after layer of corruption that extends far beyond the underworld. Her journey leads her to Marcellan, the ambitious and calculating leader of a new syndicate rising from the ashes of the old. Gaining his trust, Lorenza becomes a key figure in his organization, grappling with her growing influence in the criminal world while secretly working to destroy the remnants of the old syndicate.
As she unravels the web of power behind the syndicate, Lorenza discovers that the criminal enterprise is backed by the city’s most powerful elites, including the Prince of The Principality of Ilmaria himself. Torn between her need for vengeance and the growing realization that the corruption is systemic, Lorenza must decide whether to expose the truth and risk plunging the city into chaos or to embrace her role in the shadows to dismantle the system from within.
Noble Blood, Tainted Hands is a dark and compelling tale of survival, betrayal, and moral ambiguity, exploring themes of power, justice, and the personal cost of vengeance.

#Book #FeraWorld #Novel
Noble Blood, Tainted Hands
A Novel of Grit, Grace, and Gunpowder Justice
In the glittering heart of Ilmaria, where nobility waltzes through gilded halls and corruption festers in the shadows, Lorenza de Calis once wore the uniform of the Constabulary with pride. Daughter of a decorated war hero, trained in the honourable arts of defense and law, she believed she could change the system from within.
She was wrong.
Taken, broken, and cast to become a whore, Lorenza returns unbroken, armed with names, secrets, and an unwavering thirst for revenge.
A drug called Dust rots the city from the inside out, Lorenza tears through velvet and veneer alike to expose the rot at its roots. But vengeance in Ilmaria is never clean, and the price of truth may be more than flesh and blood can bear.
A brutal, elegant tale of loyalty, betrayal, and survival. Noble Blood, Tainted Hands follows one woman’s unrelenting pursuit of the people who ruined her and the cold reckoning waiting at the end of a knife.
Perfect for fans of grimdark political intrigue, rich worldbuilding, and heroines who don’t flinch.

#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld
Andreas Ibram Vandersryke is a simple man with a shaded past. Nexanda Tora is a Dragonkin youngling who has escaped her horrible past. After bumping into each other, the pair now travel Fera (Planet) together.
A vast boom in technology has shifted the Ilmarian Imperium (Nation) into the Flintlock Era, pushing forward with Cannon and rifle, the age of Magic was thought to be dying with the rise of the Gunslingers. Using gunpowder as their fuel, Gunslingers are the rising stars in magic. Able to use their magical powers to control explosions, musket balls mid-flight and gunpowder.
Following Andreas and Nexanda as they uncover the dangerous and dark "Hand of Orasil", learn about the history of Nexanda's lost heritage and uncover whom Andreas Vandersryke really is and why he is out to kill the King.

#Book #FeraWorld #ShortStory
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld #ShortStory
On a smoke-choked field of mud and blood, loyalty is tested and honour has a price.
Wineday the 13th of Dusk, 1763.
The First War of Alrussian Aggression has raged for more than twenty five years. Lines of infantry trade volleys beneath thunderous cannon fire. Men fall. The earth itself seems to rot with war.
From a ridge above the chaos, Rufus Langhorne of the One-Hundred and Twenty Fifth Household Guard watches and waits. His orders are clear: hold position until called. But when the centre begins to break and the city of Versal stands on the brink, waiting is no longer an option.
What follows is a desperate cavalry charge into churned earth and disciplined gunfire. A mission many call suicide. A test of command, courage and the terrible cost of duty.
In the clash of sabre and bayonet, amid smoke so thick it blinds and blood so heavy it slicks the reins, one question remains:
What does it truly mean to hold the line?
Hold the Line is a gritty military short story set in the wider Fera World universe. Perfect for readers who enjoy historical inspired warfare, intense battlefield realism and character driven tales of honour and sacrifice.

#Book #ShortStory
He woke in a hospital with no memory.
No name. No past. One missing leg.
Then the war begins.
When soldiers storm the building, they weren’t alone. Skeletal warriors advance with hellfire in their eyes. A Horseman rides the corridors of the dying.
Winged figures blaze through shattered glass to save him.
Caught between forces that call themselves Angels and others branded as demons, one broken man must survive long enough to discover the truth:
Who he is.
Why they fear him.
And why no matter how many times they try to kill him...
He keeps coming.

Moonday, 16th of Midyear, 1008.
Ruka of Stormwall, known as The White Wolf, is a Shikari — a professional hunter of the unnatural. He walks the roads others fear, takes contracts others refuse, and finishes what others cannot.
When a powerful merchant hires him to investigate a string of brutal caravan attacks along a vital trade route, Ruka expects danger.
He does not expect what he finds.
Bodies torn open. Survivors whispering of something that runs like a man and hunts like a beast. Tracks that lead into the forest and do not return.
As night falls and steel is drawn, Ruka must face whatever waits in the dark between Stargarde (Town) and Brinebury (Town).
On the Shikari’s path, coin is simple.
Monsters are not.

Pauwell Von Dietingen, an apparently travelling merchant fights off the assassins of the ancient Umissian Sultanates Death Guard aboard the luxury of the Intercontinental Locomotive spanning Ilmaria to Umissia
In the heart of the divided continent known commonly as 'The Three Kingdoms', where political tensions simmer beneath the surface, Pauwell Von Dietingen, a suave and enigmatic businessman has embarked on a journey that will unintentionally test his mettle. "Trouble on the Intercontinental" is a thrilling tale set aboard the luxurious Intercontinental Express, a high-speed locomotive cutting through the lands of the Ilmarian Imperium, Alrussian Federation and finally ending in the Umissian Republic.
Pauwell Von Dietingen finds himself in the elite surroundings of the train's opulent business class cabin, heading from the Ilmarian Capital to the Umissian Capital on a simple business trip. However, little does he know that this seemingly routine journey is about to take a deadly turn as trouble brews on the Intercontinental Express
As the train hurtles through the breathtaking landscapes of Ilmaria and Alrussia, it becomes apparent that trouble is a foot.

The crew of Humanity’s Cradle is supposed to sleep for fifty-five more years.
Chief Engineer David Jackson wakes up alone.

#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld
A soldier left to die on The Front waits for rescue, only for Colonel Hildegunde von Vernichtung to drop in like an angel.
An angel of death.
"A Child's War" is a harrowing short story set during a wartime assault in Fera's "The Third War of Alrussian Aggression", 1934. From the perspective of an Ilmarian soldier whom finds himself trapped in the midst of a brutal battle on the front lines, the soldier is confronted by a mysterious and deadly young girl, Colonel Hildegunde von Vernichtung.
This dark and suspenseful narrative explores the moral complexities of war, the brutal realities faced by soldiers on the front lines, and the chilling actions taken in the name of military strategy and secrecy.
An unnamed soldier serving on The Front during The Third War of Alrussian Aggression heads out into the battlefield as part of an engagement. The Soldier is wounded and takes cover in a destroyed building, spending days alone; he sits guarding the approach hoping that someone might rescue him.
That is when Colonel Hildegunde von Vernichtung arrives. Dropping into the building using her special fligt equipment, Hildegunde was on a mission deep into enemy lines, attempting to sew disorder behind the lines between several factions and cultures within the Alrussian Army as part of the Special Deep Air Insertion Division.
Asking her if she was there to rescue him, she laughs and tells him she was going to kill him to keep him quiet. Doing so and destroying the body with grenades he had saved as to keep her mission secret.

5.-books/published/short-story/faithless.description:
#Book #Faithless
Infobox
#Book #Faithless
Faith in Drugs is a raw exploration of a young woman's struggle with addiction and the turmoil of her fractured relationships. Faith Hopkins, a rebellious teenager in the small town of Willowbrook, battles an escalating dependency on drugs while navigating a strained relationship with her overbearing stepfather, Paul, and a distant connection with her mother. Haunted by feelings of isolation and disillusionment, she turns to drugs as both an escape and a coping mechanism. Her journey through the highs and lows of substance abuse reveals moments of vulnerability, fleeting hope, and painful self-awareness as Faith grapples with the consequences of her choices and the difficulty of finding a path forward.
In the shadow of a life ravaged by addiction and toxic love, Faith finds herself trapped in an RV that has become both her prison and her refuge. Bound to Joe, a volatile and manipulative man spiralling out of control, Faith has lost sight of the person she used to be. But when a desperate betrayal forces her to confront the darkness surrounding her, she must decide if she has the strength to break free.
With only a loyal, scrappy dog, Sam, as her anchor, Faith begins a harrowing journey away from the wreckage of her past and toward a fragile hope for redemption. Along the way, she battles her inner demons, the painful scars of her relationships, and the daunting prospect of starting over.
Told with raw honesty and unflinching emotion, Faith In Drugs is a story about survival, resilience, and the messy, imperfect road to recovery. As Faith struggles to rebuild her life, she learns that sometimes, it’s not about forgetting where you’ve been but finding the courage to believe in a future where you can thrive.
Heart-breaking yet hopeful, this short story is a gripping exploration of identity, redemption, and the transformative power of self-belief; even when the odds seem insurmountable.

#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld
At the age of 40 years old, Wilbert Vincent runs a construction business, called in to do restoration work on a church in Shoreditch (Town), a small town that became a district of Ilmaria (City) when it was swallowed up in the towns expansion, he finds himself in the clutches of a dark cult.
Stranded in the heart of darkness.
When architect Wilbert Vincent accepts the challenge of restoring an isolated chapel steeped in history, he expects quiet nights and hard work. But as his days there stretch on, strange sounds echo through the stone halls, the sisters' pious chants take on an unsettling tone, and the enigmatic Sister Anolice seems to know more than she lets on.
Each night brings new unease—whispers from unseen corners, shadows that seem alive, and a growing sense that the chapel is far more than stone and mortar. As Wilbert becomes entwined with the secrets of the sisters and the rituals they guard, he realizes he may have awakened something ancient and powerful, something that will not let him go.
Suspenseful and atmospheric, For Whom The Bells Toll explores the thin line between devotion and dread. Some mysteries are best left undisturbed—but what happens when the choice is no longer yours?

Power. Wealth. Control.
Iris Stüber has spent her life at the top of the world.
Heiress to one of the richest families in the Alrussian Federation (Nation), she is the face of luxury, influence, and untouchable privilege. At just sixteen, she is already a weapon in her father’s empire; paraded, desired, and used to secure power.
But power attracts enemies.
When a brutal, highly organised group tears her from her gilded life, Iris is thrust into a nightmare far removed from wealth and status. Stripped of control, cut off from everything she has ever known, she is forced to confront a reality where her name means nothing… and survival is no longer guaranteed.
As the days drag on and the pressure mounts, one truth becomes clear:
This was never just about ransom.
Caught between ruthless captors and the shadow of her father’s influence, Iris must endure, adapt, and decide what kind of person she truly is when everything is taken from her.
And when the dust settles…
she may not be the same girl who was taken.
Dark, unflinching, and emotionally charged, Heiress is a gripping short story of power, cruelty, survival, and transformation; set in the brutal world of Fera.
Because sometimes, being born into power is the most dangerous thing of all.

5.-books/published/short-story/old-wound.description:
#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld
Work, war, love, and the scars that never quite fade.
Mike thought his life was finally steady. A quiet job at the paper, a shared flat, late nights editing copy and writing his own novel. Levi kept him focused, sharp-tongued, relentless—and utterly irresistible. Together, they had built something fragile but real out of deadlines, shared history, and unspoken devotion.
But the past has a habit of returning.
When Frank, a former lover and fellow veteran, re-enters Mike’s life, old wounds reopen. Prosthetic limbs, phantom pain, and memories of war linger beneath the surface, blurring the line between comfort, desire, and betrayal. One mistake shatters trust, forcing Mike to confront what love truly costs—and how far he is willing to go to make things right.
Set against the quiet rhythms of everyday life and the long shadows cast by conflict, this short story is an intimate exploration of desire, passion, guilt, forgiveness, and commitment. Raw, emotional, and unapologetically adult, it is a tale about damaged people choosing each other—and the heated, sensual connection that keeps drawing them back together.
Sometimes love survives not because it is perfect, but because it is worth fighting for.

#Book #FeraWorld
Protagonist; Wright Sherris
A celebration. A stranger. A night that should never have happened.
Wright Sherris had every reason to celebrate. A promotion, a full purse, and a long night of drink behind him; life was finally beginning to look up.
Then he met her.
Drawn into the depths of Capital Park by a woman as intoxicating as she is mysterious, Wright finds himself swept into a night of indulgence, temptation, and reckless abandon. Beneath the moonlit sky, among masked strangers and whispered promises, the line between pleasure and danger begins to blur.
But something is wrong.
What begins as a chance encounter quickly spirals into something far more sinister.
Dark, atmospheric, and deeply unsettling, On A Night Darkly is a gripping short story of temptation, cult ritual, and creeping cosmic horror set within the shadowed world of Fera.
Because some invitations are not meant to be accepted.
...On a Night Darkly.

5.-books/published/short-story/the-lost-.description:
#Book #VoidApostasy
Infobox
#Book #VoidApostasy
Plot Summary:
Set during the brutal war between The Kingdom of the Divine and its enemies, "The Lost and the Damned - A Writer's Firestorm" follows CWD-9946 Writer, a soldier from Thirteenth Platoon, who becomes the sole survivor of a catastrophic battle on the war-torn planet of Dementianopolis. As the battle rages, CWD-9946 Writer is forced to call in a devastating artillery strike on his own position to prevent an overwhelming enemy advance, leaving him surrounded by death and destruction.
After the strike, Thirteenth Platoon is left shattered, with few soldiers left to continue fighting. CWD-9946 Writer receives an order to "delay and die well," and must rally what remains of his platoon to hold the line against relentless enemy assaults. His commander, AWN-1406, is killed during the battle, and CWD-9946 Writer takes control of the platoon, trying to coordinate amidst the chaos and static from higher command. The enemy continues to press forward in overwhelming numbers, and despite reinforcements being impossible to secure, CWD-9946's determination leads him to make an unexpected decision.
Facing insurmountable odds, CWD-9946 Writer calls in another artillery strike—this time aimed directly at his own position—desperately trying to thin the enemy forces and give his soldiers a slim chance of survival. With the battle escalating into pure hand-to-hand combat, no one knows what will become of Thirteenth Platoon. The soldier’s fight becomes not only one for survival but an existential struggle with the cost of loyalty, morality, and hope in an unforgiving galaxy.
In a war where survival seems futile and the concepts of duty and sacrifice are increasingly warped, CWD-9946 Writer must grapple with his humanity as he witnesses the full horror of interstellar combat, both on the battlefield and in the heart of his fellow soldiers.
"The Lost and the Damned: A Writer's Firestorm" is a dark and gritty tale of survival and duty set against the backdrop of interstellar war. In the war-torn universe of The Void Apostasy, where time is warped by the very void between stars, a deadly struggle unfolds on the ravaged surface of Dementianopolis. CWD-9946 Writer, the lone survivor of a brutal battle, stands as a symbol of both destruction and perseverance amidst the chaos of battle. His platoon is decimated, and after calling in a destructive artillery strike on his own position to halt a deadly enemy surge, CWD-9946 Writer is left to face the grim task of holding the line, cut off and betrayed by command.
Now, the war becomes not just a fight against an unrelenting enemy, but a desperate search for meaning in a world ravaged by loss. CWD-9946 Writer’s struggle will test his limits and beliefs. The boundaries of morality, leadership, and survival blur as the horrors of war descend upon the soldiers of Thirteenth Platoon. With only the promise of a long, painful delay, the question becomes: how much will one soldier sacrifice to fulfil an impossible order?
"The Lost and the Damned: A Writer's Firestorm" is a tale of brutal sacrifices, the hell of war, and the fragile hope that even in the darkest hours, humanity might yet find a reason to keep fighting.

#Book #FeraWorld
Infobox
#Book #FeraWorld
In the heart of Beauvon, death is only the beginning.
Silas Hulins was never meant to survive the battlefield. A farmer’s son thrust into war, he should have died where he fell—another forgotten casualty beneath the trees of The Beauvon Wood.
But something found him first.
Thyliase nin s'o cima, Murah ve s'o uh'el tan is no human. A child of the forest, bound by ancient laws and a deadly pilgrimage, she should have killed Silas the moment she laid eyes on him. Instead, she saves him. He becomes her secret… her burden… and something far more dangerous.
As Silas heals beneath the canopy of a living, breathing world, the line between captor and protector begins to blur. Drawn together by curiosity, instinct, and a powerful, forbidden connection, their bond deepens into something neither of them understands.
In a forest where nature itself watches, and ancient laws demand blood, their fragile connection comes at a cost.
Because in Beauvon, love is not just forbidden…
—it is punishable by death.
Blending dark fantasy, sensual tension, and emotional depth, The Seeds of Beauvon is a gripping tale of survival, transformation, and the dangerous beauty of crossing lines that should never be crossed.

Thylaise nin s'o cima, Murah ve s'o uh'el tan
Silas Hulins

Reinhold Cunningham, a Professor at the The Tousir Imperial Academy finds an ancient Üstün book within a temple wiped clean of any iconography.
What he unleashes is what the ancient elves could not destroy but only contain.
The Usta Zalim
In "The Usta Zalim," join Reinhold Cunningham, a seasoned History Professor at The Tousir Imperial Academy, as he embarks on an expedition that will forever alter the course of his life. Returning from an archaeological dig with what appears to be an ordinary empty book bearing the no title but the Üstün word “Tehlikela". Dangerous.
As he delves into the enigmatic tome, Cunningham soon realizes that this seemingly innocuous artifact is far more perilous than he could have ever imagined. The book's mysterious contents begin to consume his thoughts, warp his perceptions, and change him in ways that defy explanation.
With each passing day, Cunningham becomes entangled in a web of secrets, ancient rituals, and a malevolent force that threatens to unravel the very fabric of his reality.
"The Usta Zalim" is a riveting tale of a historian's descent into madness, as he races against time to unlock the secrets of the malevolent book and save himself from a fate worse than death. Will Reinhold Cunningham's quest for knowledge lead to his salvation or his ultimate undoing?

#FeraWorld #VoidApostasy #CitadelOfDarkness #TunnelsOfDespair #METRO #SciFiSetting #Net #LongWar
Welcome to my Wiki! I decided that if I have to pay for ALL this a year, I will add all my stuff to here, not just my Fera World!
There are a wide selection of books available for purchase either through the main website: http://lewisstockton.com/ or your favourite retailers! You can even find them on your Amazon store of choice!
You can find a list of the books here:
List of Books
I also have Fanfictions which are available on most websites, but will be available to read here too:
List of Fanfictions
Each 'Verse has its own section which you can access. You can use the search bar to find it via these tags or in the explorer at the side.
WORLDS/VERSES Tags
Fera - #FeraWorld
Void Apostasy #VoidApostasy
Citadel Of Darkness #CitadelOfDarkness
Tunnels of Despair #TunnelsOfDespair
Metro Of Ashes - #METRO
Unnamed_Sci Fi_Setting - #SciFiSetting
.Net #Net
The Long War #LongWar
<< WARNING >>
Content on this site will be considered Not Safe For Work, there are depictions of nudity and violent actions, this world is not a safe world, it's a real world; fucked up shit happens.
Change Log
If you are here to Roleplay, you can find starters linked below or by going to the section listed on the side bar:
Roleplay Starters
Welcome to the World of Fera, the custom fantasy world set up by Lewis Stockton for the use of his books, novels, table top roleplay games and in-universe roleplays!
Please see below for links leading to various sections.
For a quick Fera World Basic Information page, please use the link <<

Timeline
Fera World Character List
Welcome to the Void Apostasy universe! A science fiction universe set thousands of years in the future where a tyrannical human Empire attempts to keep itself from falling apart, beset by aliens, mutants and heretics.
Welcome to the section dedicated to the novel Citadel of Darkness (Novel). A dark world where a writer must create his own way out of Limbo.
Citadel of Darkness Character List
Faithless is a contemporary, character-driven drama that follows the raw, spiraling life of a teenage girl named Faith; angry, aimless, and already burned out before adulthood. Set in a grim, decaying world of broken homes and forgotten streets, the series explores the inner life of a girl who’s been failed by everything meant to protect her: family, school, society, and even herself.
Faith is volatile. Sharp-tongued. Self-destructive. She moves through her world like a fuse already lit — looking for something worth burning down. Each chapter drags her deeper into violence, co-dependence, and fleeting highs as she pushes against the hollow systems around her and the growing emptiness within.
Themes include:
Faith and the lack of it – not religious, but personal: trust, love, stability, future.
Survival without guidance – what happens when no one is coming to save you.
Anger as identity – how pain curdles into performance.
Beauty in the breakdown – fleeting moments of tenderness in lives full of ash.
The tone is stark, intimate, and unfiltered. There are no heroes. No redemption arcs. Just the truth as she sees it, told in scars, smirks, and cigarette smoke.
The title Faithless is both her name and her condition — a girl with no faith left in anything, least of all herself.
Faithless Character List
Welcome to the World of "Metro of Ashes." A hundred or so years after a catastrophic war, the world is a wasteland of frozen radioactive shit., Humanity survives in bunkers and underground facilities; few alive remember what happened or what caused their extinction.
Some say nuclear war, some say extra terrestrial beings.
What people do know is they are safer underground in the Ashes of the Old World.
